function.name: execute
function.arguments:
{"command":"python - <<'PY'
p='/work/output/review.py';s=open(p).read();s=s.replace("d=d.rename(columns={'class_pred':'class_file','low_confidence_pred':'lc_file'});d['class']=d['class_file'];d['low_confidence']=d['lc_file']","d=d.rename(columns={'class_pred':'class_file','low_confidence_pred':'lc_file','class':'class_annotation','low_confidence':'lc_annotation'});d['class']=d['class_annotation'];d['low_confidence']=d['lc_annotation']")
s=s.replace("'pred_vs_annotation_class_mismatch':int((d['class_file']!=d['class']).sum()),'pred_vs_annotation_LC_mismatch':int((d['lc_file']!=d['low_confidence']).sum())","'pred_vs_annotation_class_mismatch':int((d['class_file']!=d['class_annotation']).sum()),'pred_vs_annotation_LC_mismatch':int((d['lc_file']!=d['lc_annotation']).sum())")
s=s.replace("wb_sheet(w,'未进预测标注',a[~a.section_id.isin(pred.section_id)]", "wb_sheet(w,'未入趋势意见',unmatched[['project_opinion_id','sc_project_case_id','sc_url','sc_opinion_type','sc_year']]);wb_sheet(w,'未进预测标注',a[~a.section_id.isin(pred.section_id)]")
s=s.replace("wb_sheet(w,'专家类别时期',a.assign", "wb_sheet(w,'折0逐段定位',d[d.test_num==0][['section_id','url','year','class','predicted_label','low_confidence','correct','entropy','prob_GRAND','prob_NONE','prob_FORMAL']]);wb_sheet(w,'专家类别时期',a.assign")
open(p,'w').write(s)
PY
cat > /work/output/requirements.txt <<'EOF'
pandas
numpy
openpyxl
python-docx
EOF
cat > /work/output/运行说明.txt <<'EOF'
运行入口（Python 3）：在本目录执行 python review.py --input /app/input_files --output /work/output
依赖见 requirements.txt；仅用本地原件，不联网、不训练。默认输入输出即上述路径。若输入目录另有位置，传入 --input 和 --output；脚本需要与保留notes字段的case_analysis.json置于同一目录。重建时可从本交付目录复制review.py、case_analysis.json及requirements.txt到空输出目录执行；脚本将重写JSON的cases数组、DOCX及XLSX，保留人工法律判断notes。预计读入sc_data.csv和reasoning.csv共约1.2GB，逐块处理，但扫描耗时及内存取决于机器；本地运行已成功。
工作簿「年度趋势」从reasoning.csv既有zformal重建，不能从现有材料再现全部逐段推断。case_analysis.json中notes是人工式判读，不是模型自动产物；cases有原文短引、字符位置和上下文摘录。对于正式法律使用必须重新查权威出处。正文中作者原Figure 9的表述与提供的zformal数列后期均值之间的差异为审计发现，不主张识别其图形加工细节或重做模型实验。
EOF
cd /work/output && python review.py > /work/run.log 2>&1; tail -5 /work/run.log; python - <<'PY'
from openpyxl import load_workbook
from docx import Document
import json
w=load_workbook('证据与复核工作簿.xlsx',read_only=True);d=Document('法律研究工具审查意见.docx');j=json.load(open('case_analysis.json'));print('sheets',[(x,w[x].max_row) for x in w.sheetnames]);print('doc paragraphs',len(d.paragraphs),'cases',len(j['cases']),'unmatched',[x['section_id'] for x in j['cases'] if x['offset']<0]);print('file',len(open('review.py').read()))
PY","timeout":120}

tools.description: Execute a shell command in an isolated Linux environment. Original files are read-only at /input and /app/input_files; persistent writable workspace is /work. Commands have a 120 second limit. Read actual files, make native Office artifacts, and inspect execution results.
